services.label: Services
services.title: The agency that connects you with the talent you need
services.description: With BNJ Team Maker, outsourcing becomes a strategic growth lever. We find the most qualified profiles for you, ready to integrate into your team and help you reach your goals faster. You delegate, we place the best international talents. You save time, we bring you value.

list.title: Outsourcing
list.description: Providing top talents for various missions (short, medium, or long term) while reducing your HR costs
list.objective: Transform an aging frontend into a modern, high-performance interface.

list.title: Simplified management
list.description: We invest capital and human resources in your company
list.objective: Deliver reliable, efficient interfaces designed to last.

list.title: Insurance
list.description: Fast response in case of employee departure as well as future recruitments, with the aim of ensuring business continuity

list.title: Training
list.description: Develop your employees’ skills with experts specialized in their field to improve productivity and strengthen team spirit

list.title: End-to-End Fullstack Development
list.description: I handle projects from start to finish: Nuxt frontend, NestJS backend, database, integration, and optimization. I design complete and consistent architectures built for stability and scalability.
list.objective: Deliver a complete, technically solid product ready for production.

list.title: Technical Audit and Performance Optimization
list.description: I thoroughly analyze your application (frontend and backend) to identify bottlenecks, architecture issues, code duplication, or performance weaknesses. I provide a clear, prioritized report and then apply the necessary optimizations.
list.objective: Improve the quality, speed, and stability of your application.

list.title: Automation, CI/CD, and Deployment
list.description: I set up stable, automated deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins. Test automation, reliable builds, secure deployments, monitoring, and environment organization.
list.objective: Make your releases faster, safer, and perfectly reproducible.

list.title: Dashboard and Business Tools Development
list.description: I design simple and efficient internal tools: HRIS, document management, approval workflows, reporting, and custom business modules. I prioritize clarity, speed, and ease of use.
list.objective: Improve your teams’ productivity with tools adapted to their reality.

outsourcing.subtitle: Optimize your performance by delegating what matters most

list.title: Reduced operational costs
list.description: Outsourcing helps lower expenses related to recruitment, training, and internal infrastructure. You pay only for the services you use, with no additional fixed costs.

list.title: Access to specialized expertise
list.description: Immediately benefit from advanced skills and best practices thanks to professionals specialized in their field, without the need to hire or train internally.

list.title: Flexibility and adaptability
list.description: Quickly adjust your resources based on your activity, projects, or seasonality, while maintaining full control over your costs.

list.title: Focus on your core business
list.description: By delegating time-consuming tasks, your teams can focus on high-value activities, driving growth and overall performance.
